headings: PUMPKIN SPICE ACORN SCENTED CANDLES (PACK OF 5)

jsonld_raw.name: PUMPKIN SPICE ACORN SCENTED CANDLES (PACK OF 5)
jsonld_raw.description:
Small scented candles shaped like acorns.

Pumpkin Spice | An invitation to your fondest memories. Warm, surprising spices reveal a delicious, sweet pumpkin accord intertwined with creamy notes of sandalwood and cashmere.

Fragrance notes:
Top notes: Citrus, Nutmeg
Heart notes: Pumpkin
Base notes: Cinnamon, Spices, Cashmeran, Dry wood

The pack includes 5 units in different shapes and colors.
